_comment: SIH26038 Phase 2 — image-quality thresholds. ALL values are ENGINEERING HEURISTICS set from synthetic-fixture measurements (see docs/IMAGE_QUALITY_ASSESSMENT.md). They are NOT clinically validated. Tune on real data in later phases; never hard-code replacements in Python.

focus.comment: Laplacian variance inside retinal mask (uint8 gray, 224px reference scale). Log-normalised: score = clamp((log10(var+1)-log_lo)/(log_hi-lo)).

illumination.comment: Median gray inside mask (0-255) + non-uniformity = std of 4x4 block means inside mask.

contrast.comment: Std of gray inside mask; spread = p95-p5 guard; very high std suggests clipping/over-processing.

exposure.comment: Fraction of mask pixels near black (<=black_level) or white (>=white_level).

field_of_view.comment: mask_fraction = retinal-mask pixels / all pixels. Red-channel threshold factor is relative to image mean red.

retinal_coverage.comment: completeness = mask area / min-enclosing-circle area (1.0 = full circular field).

aggregation.comment: Any component BAD -> UNGRADABLE. Else any BORDERLINE -> BORDERLINE. Else GOOD. overall_score = mean of component scores (advisory only; status rules decide).
